name: Palantir Technologies Inc.
content: Palantir Technologies Inc. is a software company that builds platforms for integrating, managing, and securing data. The company provides three main platforms: Palantir Gotham, Palantir Foundry, and Palantir Apollo. Gotham is primarily used by government agencies for counter-terrorism and intelligence, while Foundry is designed for commercial enterprises to create a central operating system for their data. Apollo is a continuous delivery system that powers their software across environments. Palantir's technology enables organizations to analyze complex datasets to make better decisions and improve operational efficiency.

Officers

Alexander C. Karp(Date: 2004 January)

Chief Executive Officer

Dr. Karp is one of our co-founders and has served as our Chief Executive Officer since 2004 and as a member of our Board since 2003. Dr. Karp holds a B.A. from Haverford College, a J.D. from Stanford University, and a Ph.D. from Goethe University in Frankfurt, Germany.

Stephen Cohen(Date: 2020 January)

President

Mr. Cohen is one of our co-founders and has served as our President since 2020 and as a member of our Board since 2003. He previously served as our Secretary from 2003 to 2020. Mr. Cohen holds a B.S. in Computer Science from Stanford University.

David Glazer(Date: 2020 January)

Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer

Mr. Glazer has served as our Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer since 2020. He joined Palantir in 2013 and previously served as our Head of Finance. Prior to joining us, Mr. Glazer was a corporate attorney at Sullivan & Cromwell LLP. Mr. Glazer holds a B.A. from Emory University and a J.D. from Harvard Law School.

Ryan Taylor(Date: 2022 January)

Chief Revenue Officer and Chief Legal Officer

Mr. Taylor has served as our Chief Revenue Officer and Chief Legal Officer since 2022. He previously served as our Chief Legal Officer and Business Affairs Officer from 2020 to 2022. Mr. Taylor joined Palantir in 2010. Mr. Taylor holds a B.S. and M.S. in Management Science & Engineering from Stanford University and a J.D. from Harvard Law School.

Shyam Sankar(Date: 2022 January)

Chief Technology Officer

Mr. Sankar has served as our Chief Technology Officer since 2022. He previously served as our Chief Operating Officer from 2010 to 2022. Mr. Sankar joined Palantir in 2006. Mr. Sankar holds a B.S. in Electrical and Computer Engineering from Cornell University and an M.S. in Management Science and Engineering from Stanford University.

Directors

Peter Thiel(Date: 2003 January)

Chairman of the Board

Mr. Thiel is one of our co-founders and has served as the Chairman of our Board since 2003. He is a technology entrepreneur and investor, co-founding PayPal and serving as its CEO and Chairman. He was also the first outside investor in Facebook. Mr. Thiel holds a B.A. in Philosophy from Stanford University and a J.D. from Stanford Law School.

Alexander C. Karp(Date: 2003 January)

Director

Dr. Karp is one of our co-founders and has served as our Chief Executive Officer since 2004 and as a member of our Board since 2003.

Stephen Cohen(Date: 2003 January)

Director

Mr. Cohen is one of our co-founders and has served as our President since 2020 and as a member of our Board since 2003.

Alexander Moore(Date: 2020 January)

Director

Mr. Moore has served as a member of our Board since 2020. He is a Partner at 8VC and was a co-founder of NodePrime. He was also one of the first employees at Palantir. Mr. Moore holds a B.A. in Economics from Stanford University.

Eric Woersching(Date: 2020 January)

Director

Mr. Woersching has served as a member of our Board since 2020. He is the Managing Partner of Evolute Capital and was previously a Portfolio Manager at Thiel Macro, LLC. Mr. Woersching holds a B.S. and M.S. in Electrical Engineering from Stanford University.

Lauren Friedman Stat(Date: 2020 January)

Director

Ms. Stat has served as a member of our Board since 2020. She previously served in various roles at Accenture for 15 years, including as a Managing Director. Ms. Stat holds a B.S. in Science, Technology, and Society from Stanford University.

Heather Planishek(Date: 2022 January)

Director

Ms. Planishek has served as a member of our Board since 2022. She was previously the Chief Accounting Officer of GoDaddy Inc. Ms. Planishek holds a B.S. in Accounting from the University of San Francisco.
